_meta.note: Product taxonomy for the Online Retail II giftware catalog. 'categories' is an ORDERED ARRAY: order = classification order, first match wins, and a category may appear more than once (e.g. Home Decor: specific rules early, generic catch-alls last). Each subcategory has a 'description' (used to build the LLM prompt), optional 'rules' (whole-word keywords, compiled to tolerate plurals and space/hyphen variants) and, for Non-Product only, optional 'exact_codes' / 'exact_descriptions' matched before any rules. Edit this file to re-tune classification; nothing is hardcoded in the notebook. Themes/colours (CHRISTMAS, HEART, RED) are deliberately NOT categories.
_meta.source: Keywords adapted from taxonomy_rules.py draft + extended from unmatched-description analysis of the 4,950 unique products in data/processed/retail_raw_combined.parquet
